supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: extension visible approximately one eye-width beyond the lateral canthus

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast; muzzle is significantly lighter in pixel intensity compared to the dark periocular and upper facial regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness with a slight neutral droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: distinct red/pink pigment or lesion on the lower lip/chin area, viewer-right side
other_distinctive_markers: pronounced horizontal skin folds visible across the bridge of the nose
